categories.main_business_segments: Xingyuan Environment Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: environmental equipment manufacturing (notably filter presses), energy storage and carbon neutrality solutions, and comprehensive environmental governance including water conservancy dredging, sewage treatment, and ecological restoration. The company also engages in agricultural and rural ecological equipment manufacturing and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced filter press technology for solid-liquid separation, including AI-driven fully automatic filter presses for lithium battery recycling. It employs innovative dredging and sludge treatment technologies, energy storage systems with proprietary BMS and EMS products, and digital energy management platforms leveraging big data and AI. Manufacturing processes emphasize automation, remote monitoring, and fault diagnosis to enhance efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span environmental protection, mining, metallurgy, chemical, new energy, food, and pharmaceutical industries. The company serves government and private sectors in water treatment, ecological restoration, and energy storage markets. Major end markets include domestic Chinese regions with growing demand for pollution control, resource recovery, and carbon reduction, as well as expanding overseas markets along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily concentrated in China, with headquarters and major facilities in Zhejiang Province. The company has expanded export markets across Asia, Europe, and Africa. It maintains multiple subsidiaries and project sites nationwide, including in Guizhou, Jiangsu, Hubei, and other provinces, with ongoing efforts to grow international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xingyuan Environment operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental technology and services supply chain. It manufactures core equipment like filter presses, provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for environmental projects, and manages operation and maintenance of water treatment and energy storage facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include upgrading its core equipment manufacturing with intelligent and high-pressure filter presses, expanding innovative energy storage and carbon asset businesses, and optimizing environmental engineering operations. R&D focuses on AI automation, new materials, energy digitalization, and carbon management standards, supported by multiple patents and research platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of environmental equipment, engineering and construction contracts (including EPC and PPP projects), operation and maintenance services for water and energy facilities, and carbon asset development and trading. The company also earns income from leasing and disposal of investment properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xingyuan Environment is a leading domestic player in the filter press manufacturing industry, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It holds a strong position in environmental equipment manufacturing and is expanding its footprint in emerging sectors like energy storage and carbon markets. Competitors include other specialized environmental equipment manufacturers and integrated environmental service providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.05 billion, a 43.64% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 302 million, the loss narrowed by nearly 70% compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 9.6 billion, with ongoing efforts to improve cash flow and reduce financial costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xingyuan Environment emphasizes its comprehensive technical expertise, extensive patent portfolio, and integrated service capabilities from equipment manufacturing to project operation. Its AI-enabled filter presses and full-cycle energy storage solutions provide customers with high efficiency, reliability, and environmental compliance. The company leverages strong government and private sector partnerships, along with a dual resource advantage from state-owned and private shareholders, to deliver innovative, sustainable solutions aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
